title: Afghan Minaret Restoration Marks 'Pragmatic' Taliban Approach To Cultural Heritage, Experts Say
content: Work is now underway to the restore Afghanistan's Minaret of Jam, which experts say reflects a welcome departure from the icon-smashing rule of the Taliban of the 1990s. The change contrasts with the current Taliban rulers' draconian restrictions on other facets of life in the country.

title: Russia's Starlink Rival Faces Problems In Orbit And Threats On The Ground
content: Russia is racing to build Rassvet, its answer to Starlink, after losing access to the satellite network on the battlefield in Ukraine. But troubled satellites, tight deadlines, and a lack of ground terminals could leave Moscow waiting years.

title: Kyrgyz Families Plead For Return Of Islamic State Fighters' Wives, Relatives From Iraqi Prisons

title: Suicide Attack On Police Facility In Northwest Pakistan Leaves Many Dead And Wounded
